attributes.action: Stop MPs from voluntarily resigning, then standing in the resulting by-election
attributes.background:
Change the law to prevent a current MP from standing in a by-election that was triggered by their own voluntary resignation.

Such behaviour wastes time and money, and is a misuse of the electoral system.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Prevent MPs who resign their seat from standing for re-election for 12 months" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776390
